summary: This guide helps teams place Google review cards more deliberately by tying the format to the real customer moment, surface constraints and whether staff needs to prompt the action.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
Placement often decides response rate before artwork or chip choice does.

faq.question: What usually matters most in review-card placement?
faq.answer: The most important factor is usually the customer moment itself: where people already pause, have a free hand and can act without creating queue friction or confusion.

faq.question: Should teams test several placements at once?
faq.answer: Usually only a small number. One or two controlled live placements are easier to compare than a broad rollout across every possible counter or table surface.
